variants.name: Despair
variants.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Amumu begins crying, dealing <magicDamage>@BaseDamage@ plus @TotalHealthDamage@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies every second and refreshing <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>.

variants.name: Frost Shot
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_AshePassive_Tooltip}}

The bonus damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage bonus.

stringtable.spell_ashepassive_tooltip:
Ashe's Attacks and Abilities Slow by @SlowAmount@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Attacks deal @DamageBonus@ damage.

Ashe's critical strikes deal no extra damage, instead increasing the Slow to @EmpoweredSlowAmount@ decaying.

variants.name: Relentless Assault
variants.tooltip: Jax's Attacks grant a stack for 2.5 seconds that gives him <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedPerStack@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed> (max <attackSpeed>@MaxBonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed>).

variants.name: Whisper
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_JhinPassive_Tooltip}}
Attack Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and bonus Attack Speed.
Move Speed scales with bonus Attack Speed.
Missing health damage is capped at 800 against monsters.

stringtable.spell_jhinpassive_tooltip:
Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed Attack Speed and can be fired @MaxAmmo@ times before needing to be reloaded. The @MaxAmmo@th shot always critically strikes, and deals an additional @FourthShotExecutePercent@ missing health physical damage.

In addition:
  • Jhin gains @TotalADPercent@ bonus Attack Damage
  • Jhin's critical strikes deal @CritReductionPercent*100@% less damage but grant him @CritMoveSpeedPercent@ Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds.

variants.name: Dauntless Instinct
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_KSanteP_Tooltip}}

Damage against minions has a minimum cap of 15-100 (based on level).
Damage against monsters has a maximum cap of 20-105 (based on level).

stringtable.spell_ksantep_tooltip:
K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals @FlatDamage@ plus @PercentHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage and consumes the mark.

All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional @MaxHealthDamagePercent@ max Health physical damage.

variants.name: Divine Ascent
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{ Spell_KaylePassive_Tooltip }}
Fire waves apply spell effects and can Critically Strike.

stringtable.spell_kaylepassive_tooltip:
Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank0@ - Zealous: Attacks grant @EnrageTotalASPerStack@% Attack Speed for @EnrageDuration@ seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining @MSTowardsEnemy*100@% Move Speed.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank1@ - Arisen: Attack range is increased to @UpgradedAttackRange@.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank2@ - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal @PassiveWaveDamage@ magic damage.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank3@ - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to @FinalAttackRange@.

variants.name: Defensive Ball Curl
variants.tooltip:
Rammus enters a defensive formation for @BuffDuration@ seconds, gaining @BonusArmorTooltip@ Armor and @BonusMRTooltip@ Magic Resist and dealing @ReturnDamageCalc@ magic damage to enemies that Attack him.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

variants.name: Break the Mold
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RellP_Tooltip}}

Always steals at least @StealFloor@. Does not steal from minions or Epic jungle monsters.

variants.name: Dawning Shadow
variants.tooltip: Senna fires a beam of light that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to all enemy champions hit. Allied champions hit in a wider area receive <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
variants.tooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The shield's power scales with the amount of <keywordMajor>Mist</keywordMajor> Senna has collected.</rules>

variants.name: Boomerang Blade
variants.tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@</physicalDamage> to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @FallOffMinimum*100@%.
variants.tooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
Cast time scales down with Attack Speed
